title: Korean Online Hate Speech Dataset for Multilabel Classification - How Can Social Science Improve Dataset on Hate Speech? -
reasoning: The paper's central focus is the ethical problem of hate speech. It creates a dataset with seven categories of hate speech, one of which is explicitly 'Religion'. The paper includes a detailed analysis of the nuances of religious hate speech within the South Korean cultural context, targeting groups like Protestants, Buddhists, Catholics, and Muslims. This makes the study of religion and ethics a fundamental part of the research, not just a peripheral consideration.
